notes.title: Office Lease Analysis
notes.content:
Office Lease Analysis — 2026 Planning

Current space:
- Address: 123 Market St, Suite 400, San Francisco
- Type: Flexible office (WeWork-style, operated by Hana)
- Size: 14 desks + 1 meeting room + phone booth
- Cost: $12,500/month all-inclusive (utilities, internet, cleaning)
- Lease term: 12 months, expires December 31, 2026
- Hybrid policy: team in-office 3 days/week (Mon, Tue, Thu)

Current utilization:
- Average occupancy: 9/14 desks on in-office days
- Meeting room: booked 70% of time
- Phone booth: constantly in use (need more)

Scenarios for 2027:

1. Renew current space (status quo)
- Expected: $13,000-13,500/mo (5-8% increase)
- Pro: no disruption, team likes location
- Con: will be tight if we hire 3-5 more people

2. Upgrade to larger space (same building)
- 22 desks + 2 meeting rooms: $18,000/mo
- Pro: room for growth, more meeting space
- Con: $66K/yr increase in burn

3. Move to cheaper neighborhood (SoMa/Dogpatch)
- Similar size: $9,000-10,000/mo
- Pro: saves $30-42K/yr
- Con: some team members commute gets worse

4. Go fully remote
- Stipend: $500/person/month × 14 = $7,000/mo
- Pro: saves $66K/yr net, attracts remote talent
- Con: culture impact, Sarah prefers hybrid

Recommendation: Renew current space for 6 months (negotiate month-to-month after), reassess based on team size in mid-2026.

Decision needed by: October 2026 (90-day notice required)
